name: VDN-NeRF
definition: A method to train neural radiance fields (NeRFs) for better geometry under non-Lambertian surface and dynamic lighting conditions by normalizing view-dependence through self-distillation of invariant information encoded in the learned NeRFs.
summary: VDN-NeRF trains NeRFs for high-quality geometry under non-Lambertian conditions by normalizing view-dependent radiance via self-distillation, avoiding explicit modeling of complex factors.
